payload.title: Report which events are corrupt, not just the count
payload.body: tasks doctor + fleet stats now report a corrupt-event COUNT (corruptEventCount), but not WHICH events/commits are malformed, so debugging a corrupt tasks-claims log still means manual git archaeology. Add a way to list the offending commit + path (e.g. tasks fleet doctor --verbose or a dedicated diagnostic) — readEvents already knows the spec (<commit>:<path>) of each blob it fails to parse; thread that out. Surfaced adding error+health visibility to the git-native backend.
